direct_luid_link.reason: Measured on this machine: no CIM or Win32 source exposes a LUID together with a PCI device id. Win32_PerfFormattedData_GPUPerformanceCounters_GPUAdapterMemory carries only Name and memory counters; Win32_VideoController carries PNPDeviceID but no LUID; EnumDisplayDevicesW returns PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_64A0&SUBSYS_88F21043&REV_04 for all three display adapter entries and no LUID; Win32_LUID exposes no instances and MSFT_ComputeAccelerator is not a registered CIM class on this build. The mapping is therefore resolved from the engine taxonomy, with the evidence recorded per LUID.
